Accessed [dd mmm yyyy, e.g., 01 Jan 2016]YesNAtropical evergreen broadleafAustraliaAustralia2/13/2015Record the TreeID for each tree >10cm inside the subplot. Live trees are given a sequential number 1-999. Dead trees in the initial survey are recorded as 'D' and tree ferns are recorded as 'DA' (i.e. Dicksonia Antarctica, a Tasmanian tree fern). Record the tree status as either dead (D), Alive (A) or Resprouting (R). Resprouting trees have a dead trunk, but have coppicing live foliage sprouting from the base. Record the genus and species of each tree >10cm DBH using a six letter code with three letters from the genus and three letters from the species (i.e. Eucalyptus regnans is EucReg). Record the species and six letter code used in the Plot Establishment Data Sheet. For trees that cannot be identified, take a photo and a well labelled voucher specimen for identification at the State Herbaria.
